allow: PowerShell(foreach \($c in 'arduino-cli','pio','platformio','code'\) { $g = Get-Command $c -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($g\) { "$c -> $\($g.Source\)" } else { "$c -> NOT FOUND" } })

PowerShell($p = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\\Programs\\Arduino IDE"; if \(Test-Path $p\) { "Arduino IDE installed at $p" } else { "No Arduino IDE in LOCALAPPDATA" }; $ext = Get-ChildItem "$env:USERPROFILE\\.vscode\\extensions" -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'arduino|platformio|serial|cortex' } | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name; if \($ext\) { "VS Code extensions:"; $ext } else { "No arduino/platformio VS Code extensions found" })

PowerShell($g = Get-Command winget -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($g\) { "winget -> $\($g.Source\)" } else { "winget -> NOT FOUND" }; Get-PnpDevice -Class Ports -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Status,FriendlyName | Format-Table -AutoSize)
